item.title: From urban rooftops to working cattle farms: Australia’s best home gardens – in pictures
item.description: The 20 best residential gardens have been revealed in the first-ever Landscape Australia awards shortlist. Jury chair Emily Wong said each project was a response to urgent issues such as the climate crisis, fire and flood resilience, and the loss of biodiversity. They saw gardens as ‘part of a larger living commons that supports different ecologies and also … the future of Australian cities’. Wong also noted that private gardens take up a large quantity of space in Australian cities. ‘So really, these gardens are about seeing the design as a contribution to shared infrastructure’ Continue… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Queensland dairy farmer opened four campsites after drought forced her family to sell 40 cows
item.description: Agritourism is gaining momentum among Australian farmers struggling with drought-related financial pressures. Landowners like Libby Rough are transforming their properties into camping havens, creating alternative income streams. This shift not only aids in sustaining their farms during tough times but also promotes local agricultural education among visitors. Moreover, local authorities are streamlining regulations to encourage this thriving sector, enhancing community engagement with farming practices. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
